title: Approved Planogram Changes and the Call-Out Charge on a Micro Market Settlement
content:
Unscheduled planogram work approved on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement during the quarter can bring the call-out charge printed against the market format into the settlement, once or twice over according to the breadth of the range the format carries.

## Conditions

**Twice the call-out charge printed against the market format** is added where the client had at or above 2 planogram changes approved over the three months to the day the settlement is raised, and the market format carries at or above 250 distinct products.

**The call-out charge printed against the market format, once**, is added where the client had at or above 2 planogram changes approved over those three months, and the market format carries below 250 distinct products.

**Where neither condition holds**, nothing is added for planogram work.

## The two boundaries

The planogram change floor is 2 approved planogram changes over the three months to the day the settlement is raised: a quarter carrying exactly 2 meets it, and a quarter carrying 1 does not. The wide-range product count is 250 distinct products carried in the format's planogram: a format carrying exactly 250 is at or above it, and a format carrying 249 is below it.

*Hypothetical.* Three planogram changes approved in the quarter on a format carrying 420 distinct products with a printed call-out charge of 185.00 USD bring 370.00 USD into the settlement. The same three changes on a format carrying 140 distinct products with a printed call-out charge of 110.00 USD bring 110.00 USD. A single approved change in the quarter brings nothing, whatever the range.
